description.value: Matsuyama is a Japanese restaurant tucked into a Richmond strip mall, serving a broad menu of over 100 items including sushi platters sized for groups, daily bento specials, and late-night deals. The dining room features comfortable booth seating and flat-screen TVs, making it a relaxed stop for solo cyclists or a whole touring party. Delivery and take-out are also available.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 44m; rack at 77m; rack at 97m; rack at 98m.
